integration_removed.description:
The Telegram integration has been removed from Home Assistant.

It only provided legacy notify actions, which were replaced by the notify entities of the [Telegram bot integration]({url}).

To resolve this issue, remove the Telegram notify configuration (`platform: telegram`) from your `configuration.yaml` file, add your chats to the Telegram bot integration, and restart Home Assistant. Then update your automations and scripts to use the `notify.send_message` action with the Telegram bot notify entities.

Once the configuration has been removed and Home Assistant has restarted, this issue will no longer be shown.
integration_removed.title: The Telegram integration has been removed
